headline: Internal billing-operations training (not a sales conversation): invoice timing and frozen-account recovery

suggested_routes.label: Internal / product / vendor note
suggested_routes.rationale: All speakers are SpendNest team members; this is internal process training, not customer or prospect activity.
suggested_routes.output: Internal knowledge note for finance/ops reporting: (1) the invoice month does not tell you when cash arrived; due periods vary to month-end or mid-next-month (turns 7–9). (2) Zero-value invoices are not missing payments (turn 13). (3) Failed wallet deductions retry on days 3, 7 and 10, then the account freezes (turns 15–17). (4) Recovery needs operations to clear the invoice and manually fix the next billing date (turn 18). Action: Team member A will request back-office access for the trainee (turn 20).
suggested_routes.owner: Team member A (stated, turn 20: back-office access request)

evidence.quote: I have access to a demo account as an administrator, but I do not have the back-office super-admin access you mentioned.
That explains why the invoice month alone does not tell us when the cash arrived.
That is not automatically a missing payment.
Operations also needs to adjust the next billing date manually.
I will request the back-office access separately for the next training session.

concise_output: Internal billing-workflow training: no customer or prospect is present. Its value is operational knowledge. Invoice dates do not equal cash dates, zero-value invoices are expected, and frozen-account recovery needs a manual billing-date fix. It is excluded from sales coaching and from the deal/follow-up priorities.
what_established: Speakers are all SpendNest team members; billing rules were explained; back-office access will be requested for the trainee.
what_not_established: Any customer, deal, or sales activity. The example amounts (INR 6,240 / 6,110) are illustrations, not real transactions.
next_action: File the knowledge note for finance/ops; follow up on the back-office access request.
uncertainty: Earlier drafts treated this as unroutable; the full text shows it is internal training.
